root_text:
HMPV is a respiratory virus that affects people of all ages, causing symptoms like cough, fever, and congestion. HMPV is self-limiting in most cases. 

Stay healthy, stay safe!

#HumanMetapneumovirus #HMPVAwareness #ManipalInstituteOfVirolo
